question_text: Describe an algorithm to total all values in a nonempty circular singly linked list exactly once.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Set total=0 and current=head. Add current.value to total, then advance current=current.next. Repeat until current is head again, and report total.

marking_points.criterion: Stop on return to head, after processing it once.

partial_credit_notes: Award independent criteria up to the stated total; accept equivalent technically correct wording/solutions.
